scope: Bounded exact checks of route obstructions and a conditional counting lemma; no unrestricted asymptotic advance or novelty assertion.

volume_obstruction.scope: Exact determinant controls for an infinite symbolic construction; the uniform proof is in the research note.
volume_obstruction.conclusion: The full moment-polytope volume has order n^(2d) even in the generic point-ideal case. A smaller universal full-volume bound cannot improve the existing proof.

disjoint_socle_relation_control.uniform_conclusion: For this whole three-variable construction, g(I)=O(n^(4/3)); it cannot beat the existing generic n^2(log n)^2 order.
disjoint_socle_relation_control.proof_location: docs/interleaving_research.md, First feasibility pass: two rigorous route obstructions

overlapping_socle_relations.uniform_conclusion: Arbitrary relation spaces confined to the socle give O_d(n^(d(d-1)/(d+1))) initial staircases, by an antichain coordinate budget and the established lattice-polytope bound.
overlapping_socle_relations.scope_exclusion: Relations with surviving nonconstant multiples are not covered.

rectangular_spanning_control.conditional_conclusion: If every monomial box of volume at least kappa*n spans, every standard basis is determined by a geometric word of length d^d*kappa*n. The existing ordered-prefix theorem then gives O_d((kappa*n)^(d-1)(log(kappa*n+1))^(d-1)).
rectangular_spanning_control.scope_exclusion: The spanning parameter is not universally bounded; the diagonal family has growing parameter and only d initial ideals.

cartesian_rank_delay_control.uniform_conclusion: Translated Cartesian axis staircases give radical point ideals with g(I)=1, no zero monomial evaluations, and minimum geometric rank-completion length Omega_d(n^d). A linear rank-delay bound cannot be imposed on all point ideals.
